artists.biography:
Wisdom of Crowds is the exciting new project featuring Bruce Soord from The Pineapple Thief with Jonas Renkse from Katatonia.
Originally written with Renkse’s voice in mind, Soord sought out the acclaimed Katatonia vocalist to complete the compositions and release the music to the masses. Despite the rigorous schedules of The Pineapple Thief and Katatonia, the two musicians were eventually able to connect.
Both artists are currently enjoying unparalleled success with their main bands.

perplexity.description:
The album Bruce Soord is the eponymous debut solo album by Bruce Soord, the frontman and principal songwriter of the progressive rock band The Pineapple Thief. Released in 2015 on the Kscope label, the album showcases a more introspective and organic side of Soord’s songwriting, diverging somewhat from the progressive and alternative rock fusion typical of his band. It explores deeply personal themes of memory, place, and identity through a rock framework that balances melodic sensibility with atmospheric textures.

In the context of Soord’s discography, this album marked his first major solo statement outside The Pineapple Thief, setting a foundation for his subsequent solo works such as All This Will Be Yours (2019) and Luminescence (2023). Critically, the album was well-received for its emotional depth and nuanced production, highlighting Soord’s multi-instrumental talents and his ability to craft intimate yet expansive rock music. While not a commercial blockbuster, it solidified his reputation as a versatile artist within the progressive rock community and contributed to his ongoing evolution as a solo musician alongside his band career.
